en: Black-and-white historical street view showing a cobblestone road with tram tracks running down the center in a European city. Several pedestrians in long coats and hats walk along the street, and a tram or horse-drawn streetcar is visible in the distance. Multi‑story brick and stucco buildings line the right side, with lower wooden houses and bare trees on the left. Printed text at the top identifies the location as a street in Malmö and credits the photographer and date.
